constraints: Hides all windows and the menu bar belonging to process; the process keeps executing while hidden, and is only made visible again by SHOW PROCESS. No-op if the process is already hidden.
The Debugger window is a special exception: if it needs to display while process is hidden, process is shown and becomes frontmost.
The Main Process and Cache Manager processes cannot be hidden with this command.
To keep a process's UI hidden from the moment it's created, call HIDE PROCESS as the first statement of the process method.
